narrative.intro: Csi Aviation has $1.3B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 9 awards, with an average award size of $143M and obligations up 94.9% year over year. Csi Aviation received $1.3B from the Department of Homeland Security in FY2026 to date, with smaller purchases from the Department of Defense ($1.7M) and the Department of Energy ($721K). Csi Aviation shows a steady rise in obligations since FY21: $2.4M in FY21, $4.8M in FY22, $162M in FY23, $350M in FY24, $661M in FY25, and $1.3B in FY26. Csi Aviation’s largest market by NAICS is All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at $1.3B, followed by Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date) and the note on the page clarifies that the figures shown are contract obligations except for award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values.

sections.heading: What drove the FY2026 to date total?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security drove the FY2026 to date total with $1.3B in obligations. Csi Aviation’s largest NAICS market, All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services, also equals $1.3B. The company’s FY26 total follows a multiyear rise from $2.4M in FY21 to $661M in FY25, then to $1.3B in FY26.

sections.heading: Who are the primary buyers and what do they buy?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the primary buyer with $1.3B in obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K. The largest NAICS market is All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at $1.3B, with Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M.

faq.q: How much does Csi Aviation make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Csi Aviation has $1.3B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date and 9 awards with an average award size of $143M. Obligations are up 94.9% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Csi Aviation?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security buys most from Csi Aviation, obligating $1.3B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K.

faq.q: What does Csi Aviation sell to the government?
faq.a: Csi Aviation sells services classified under All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services, which totals $1.3B in FY2026 to date. Csi Aviation also has work in Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M.
